preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and 1 <= len(stdin) <= 100 and all(c in 'ABC.' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input is a non-empty string of length at most 100, containing only 'A', 'B', 'C', and '.'.

postconditions.expression: stdout in ['Yes', 'yes'] if any('A' in stdin[i-1:i+2] and 'B' in stdin[i-1:i+2] and 'C' in stdin[i-1:i+2] for i in range(len(stdin))) else stdout in ['No', 'no']
postconditions.description: The output is 'Yes' if there exists at least one cell that can contain all three colours 'A', 'B', and 'C' after some flowers shed their petals, otherwise 'No'.
